summary: Card collection, deckbuilding, regional BO3 battles, and post-loss rebuild form the main loop.
Combat combines turn order, action count, unit positioning, energy costs, counter cards, evolution requirements, fragments, and left-to-right damage resolution.
The colorless-to-grass transition exposes unit ratio, energy mismatch, evolution prerequisites, and draw variance as core deckbuilding risks.
